info.li: Single-nucleus RNA-seq (snRNA-seq) embryo subclustering view (Level 3 annotation, level_3_annotation_full_timed) from the same dataset and paper as at_seed_martin.xml: Martin, Cogdill, Pusey & Gehring (2026) Nature Plants 12:1133–1149. DOI: 10.1038/s41477-026-02295-8. GEO accession GSE295007.

Control: as with the L2 seed view, there is no single biological control sample — the relative (log₂ ratio) view is centred on the median of all displayed embryo-subtype pseudobulk means for a given gene, matching this tool's existing expression_to_color_relative(median_ctrl, ...) convention. Med_CTRL is a synthetic placeholder representing that computed median, not a real GSM sample.

Tissue ids below are the literal, verbatim id attributes from at_seed_l3_template_martin.svg (including the embedded numbering, DAP prefix, and marker-gene parentheticals, e.g. 5DAP 5. EMB vascular primordium and hypophysis (SHR and PIN4)) — confirmed against the SVG with no synthetic/compound keys.

Cell-type groups harmonize the same embryo subtype across timepoints where the underlying biological structure recurs (e.g. Upper protoderm spans 3/5/7 DAP), per the paper's embryo subclustering analysis (Fig. 1f–i): upper/lower protoderm, suspensor, cortical initials, vascular primordium, ground tissue initials, hypophysis, and inner cotyledon.

Note: the paper reports 5 subclusters in the 3 DAP embryo and 6 in the 5 DAP embryo, but this SVG only draws 2 of the 3DAP subtypes (upper protoderm, suspensor) and 4 of the 5DAP subtypes (upper protoderm, lower protoderm, cortical initials, the combined vascular-primordium-and-hypophysis cluster) — consistent with the same curated-snapshot pattern already flagged for the L2 seed view. The 5DAP vascular primordium and hypophysis are not separately resolved as distinct clusters (drawn as one combined region), unlike at 7DAP where they are split into two ids; both are grouped together here under "Vascular primordium and hypophysis" to avoid listing the same SVG id under two groups.

Sample replicate assignment per timepoint, from GSE295007 (identical to the L2 seed view): 3DAP = GSM8939988 (rep1a), GSM8939989 (rep1b), GSM8939990 (rep2); 5DAP = GSM8939991 (rep1), GSM8939992 (rep2); 7DAP = GSM8939993 (rep1), GSM8939994 (rep2).
